name: motion-fade
title: Motion Fade
description: Fade a mounting element in — the preconfigured <MotionFade> preset built on the motion engine. Zero runtime deps (tw-animate-css).

aria: Preserves child semantics and accepts reduced-motion behavior from the motion foundation.
consumer: Keep content available without animation and avoid fading essential feedback too quickly.
limitations: Motion safety depends on the selected transition and consumer composition.
